notes: The live signed endpoint contains the complete 23-package Beta 2 set.
The published set includes Aero7 Desktop, Gadgets 3, the renamed Aero7 Device Manager, and optional Programs Center Beta.
Every package and repository database is signed by the documented Aero7 repository key and was validated through the public pacman endpoint.
The online and offline Aero7 ISO files are separate artifacts and are not published by this repository.
